QuestInfo.name: Top Hats and Tigers 1
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann is looking at the White Tiger with an odd look. Make sure he doesn't decide to eat it.
QuestInfo.1: Collect Nependeaths from the Wild Plant Habitat to purify and warm the air in the Hatchery.\r\nReduce a Nependeath's HP, then double click on #i2270024:#, the pouch Spiegelmann gave you, to capture them.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: The Hatchery is now surrounded by Nependeaths. That's probably a good thing?

0.0: Awww, really?! Where's the evil dragon?! Eh, whatever. I guess this thing's alright.\r\n
0.1: Keeping the temperature stable is pretty important when you're dealing with little things. And this tiger is definitely little. Could you help out?

yes.0: All right! If you survive the Sky Nest, get to the #eWild Plant Habitat#n and bring me some Nependeaths. If I plant those, they'll stabilize the atmosphere here. You got the pouch I gave you, right? The one that looks like a #i2270024:#. Just knock a Nependeath's HP down and double click them to stick them in the pouch.
yes.1: I guess I ought to warn you about the plant-food I accidentally gave them that turned them all into giant flesh-eating monsters, huh? Nah, I'm sure you'll be fine. Just hurry up!

no.0: Don't you feel like you should do something for this squishy little guy? Come on!

yes.0: The air's gonna be great in here!

item.0: Really? All you gotta do is lower their HP and put them in the pouch! How hard is it to beat up a rabid plant?!
